task_description: PYTRADE Phase 2 Part 1: Build Auth+Onboarding flow, KYC+Banking wizard, and Markets+Trading UI on top of the existing Next.js 16 + Tailwind CSS v4 demo platform. Three sequential features: FEAT-001 (Auth/Onboarding), FEAT-002 (KYC/Banking), FEAT-003 (Markets/Trading). Each must leave the build passing before the next starts.
